theorem typeI1_le {α x δ Q₀ U : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx2 α x δ a q Q₀)
    (hU : √3 ≤ U) (hUx : U ≤ min (x / 4) (x / rexp 1)) (hUQ : U ≤ Q₀ / 2) :
    ‖typeILog α x U‖ ≤
      x / (2 * q) * minInv c₀ (π * δ) *
          ((2 * q / Nat.totient (2 * q) + 2.67) + Real.log (x / U) * muBound U q) +
        x / (2 * q) * logFourierBound δ * muBound U q +
        c₀ * (1 / 2 - 2 / π ^ 2) * (U ^ 2 / (4 * q * x) * Real.log (rexp (1 / 2) * x / U) +
          1 / rexp 1) +
        bound_4_41 x q U :=

note: `MinorArcs.typeI1_le` states the bound with main term (x/2q)·min(1, c₀/(πδ)²) for c₀ = 32, sums over (m,2q)=1, η̂ evaluated at −δ/2, and the remainder `MinorArcs.bound_4_41`, whose last term has log(2ex/c₂) in place of log(2√e x/c₂). The main terms are in `MinorArcs.bound_4_40`.
